# Connectors and pinouts (v0.3)

Every plug on the box edge. **J1-J8 face the stock harness:** each must be the mate of the stock plug so the box swaps with the stock HY2005RX controller (plug and play). Their families, pin counts and pin order are **TBD** until the photos of the stock plugs (#17); the pin numbers below are our own until then. **J9-J12 are our own** sealed plugs for parts the stock car doesn't have.

J8 and J9 each carry a supply line (12 V lights, 24 V coil chain) next to a 3.3 V input of U24. A pin-to-pin short there could reach the PCF8574, so keep those pins apart: in J9 the coil pair (1, 2) sits away from the sense pair (3, 4); J8's order waits on the stock plug.

| Ref | Name | Pins | Faces | Part | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| J1 | BATTERY | 2 | stock harness (TBD #17) | Mate of the stock battery plug (fallback: Anderson SB50) | TBD |
| J2 | KEY | 2 | stock harness (TBD #17) | Mate of the stock key-switch plug | TBD |
| J3 | PEDAL | 3 | stock harness (TBD #17) | Mate of the stock pedal plug | TBD |
| J4 | SHIFTER | 3 | stock harness (TBD #17) | Mate of the stock shifter plug | TBD |
| J5 | STEER MOTOR | 2 | stock harness (TBD #17) | Mate of the stock steering-motor plug (fallback: XT60, owned) | TBD |
| J6 | FRONT MOTORS | 4 | stock harness (TBD #17) | Mate of the stock front-motor plug(s); if the harness pairs the motors, a reversible splitter at the motor plugs (fallback: 2 x XT60) | TBD |
